title: Ooim nachez
html_source: My edition has it “Goim nachez” which is yiddish (now “Goyim nachez”) for “Gentile’s pleasure”.

anchor.prefix:
our hand open. Lockjaw. They make you kaput, Leopoldleben. You watch them chaps.

BLOOM (Weakly.) They challenged me to a sprint. It was muddy. I slipped.

RUDOLPH (With contempt)
